raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 주말 식물 마켓을 홍보해줘. SNS에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 각각 전체 스타일과 레이아웃이 달랐으면 좋겠어. 식물을 고르고 집에서 돌보는 즐거움이 느껴지도록 만들고, 긴 설명과 방문 안내가 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 작은 이미지나 질감을 붙이는 단색 템플릿은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 다음 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

집 안의 작은 숲
LEAVES & LIVING
초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.
작은 화분부터 오래 키운 나무까지 만납니다. 재배자의 이야기를 듣고, 우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는 식물을 골라보세요.
성수 주말 식물 마켓
2027.06.12–06.13
토·일 11:00–19:00
성수 온실마당
입장 무료 · 분갈이 시연
식물 구매 시 관리 안내 제공
편하게 들러 천천히 둘러보세요.

compact_recording.execution: Inside the same fresh critic session before immutable CLI completion; no post-completion export

procedure.method: Independent fresh editorial session, with no spawn, fork, resume, peer review or producer inspection. Read the pinned literal packet, case, rules, rubric and compact instructions. The packet supplies no source assets and no protected-layout manifests, so both receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests and verified their hashes and the fifteen PNG hashes, byte counts and PNG-header dimensions before opening posters; did not follow their unlisted embedded paths. Actually opened and visually inspected each exact pinned image through tools.view_image(detail=original), emitting its original-detail image through functions.exec, one at a time in member order M1, M2, M3, M4, M5 and, within each, native, usage720, thumbnail320. Completed all fifteen initial poster opens before starting text-reading/transcription or any judgment or score. First copy readings below were then taken from the already displayed native pixels; soft wraps and optical spacing are retained, and no copy was filled from the required strings. No ambiguity-triggered revisit was needed. All natives are 1672 by 941; their landscape16:9 correctness uses the predeclared nearest-integer-single-edge tolerance: 941 minus 1672*9/16 equals 0.5 pixel, so they are rounded, not mathematically exact. Usage views are 720 by 405 and thumbnails 320 by 180, consistent with the bounded aspect-preserving downsample policy. Semantic viewing is my attestation, not a claim that hash verification proves viewing. No runtime session identifier is observable here; session_id remains null.

evidence.location: top and lower-left foreground
evidence.observation: Large detailed living leaves, soil, ceramic pots and the bench row occupy substantial canvas area and present planted houseplants of several sizes.

evidence.location: macro foliage above and small pots below title
evidence.observation: The contrast between a mature large plant and available smaller pots gives the copy about choosing specimens and keeping a small indoor forest a visible counterpart.

content_form.location: large pot above center and small-pot row at lower left
content_form.observation: The image connects mature growth, smaller plant choices, light and potting soil to the supplied indoor-plant message; the visible variety provides more than a decorative leaf symbol.

hierarchy.location: left title, center paragraph, right ruled event column
hierarchy.observation: The identity, explanatory promise and practical visit details have distinct readable roles, with the rule marking the transition to participation information.

hierarchy.location: left title and right event block
hierarchy.observation: The title survives as the main identity and the information column remains a recognizable secondary destination.

typography.location: title and center/right type
typography.observation: The Korean serif title and tracked Latin line contrast with crisp, restrained sans-serif explanation and logistics; visible copy has intact glyphs and punctuation.

typography.location: center paragraph and lower-right invitation/URL
typography.observation: The long explanation, invitation and URL can be read without crowding or leaf overlap.

space.location: center-right light opening
space.observation: Text follows the open area between upper foliage and lower pots, with clear gutters separating the three reading zones.

space.location: right column lower edge
space.observation: The invitation and URL retain a usable bottom margin and are separated from the dense leafy edge.

image_material.location: macro leaf surfaces, pot rim and lower terracotta pots
image_material.observation: Leaf veins, gloss, granular soil and differently textured pots are locally convincing. The deliberately enlarged upper plant reads as editorial image framing rather than a literal shared scale with the small bench pots.

emotion_control.location: sunlit plants around the light reading area
emotion_control.observation: Bright transmitted leaf light and the accessible row of small pots produce a warm domestic growing mood without overwhelming the calm informational copy.

ai_slop.location: plant and pot boundaries around the text
ai_slop.observation: Foliage has a coherent botanical role, edges do not invade the copy, and the soil/pot construction does not show a conspicuous unresolved artifact. The repetition of potted foliage remains content-grounded.

residuals: The choosing/caring story is quieter than M2 and M5: it is conveyed by growing plants, light, soil and size variety rather than a depicted interaction.
Its light text opening enclosed by green foliage is related to M3 and M4, which limits the set’s stylistic separation.

hierarchy.location: two diagonally placed figures

typography.location: red headline and dark-green body/event text

typography.location: paragraph and lower-right care/invitation/URL

space.location: lower-right block and surrounding objects

emotion_control.location: shopper expression and calm aproned figure

content_form.location: large leaf enclosure and right pink pots
content_form.observation: The potted diversity supports an indoor collection, but the dominant huge-leaf frame does little to distinguish selecting a specimen or learning its care. The specific weekend-market experience relies heavily on the copy.

hierarchy.location: date/market cluster above paragraph and benefits at right
hierarchy.observation: A clear date-first route prioritizes attendance, then the slogan/explanation and practical benefits; the smaller identity acts as a concluding label.

hierarchy.observation: The date retains the strongest text signal and the shaped reading channels remain distinct.

typography.location: dark-blue event/body type and green slogan/URL
typography.observation: Consistent clean gothic glyphs and simple color differentiation keep the many required lines controlled.

typography.location: five-line paragraph and right benefits block
typography.observation: Both blocks are readable with intact word spaces and punctuation. The small split Latin identity remains a secondary mark rather than the principal reading cue.

space.location: cream islands between layered leaves
space.observation: The paragraph and event cluster fit deliberate organic openings; a narrow vine separates the explanatory and practical channels rather than crossing text.

space.location: bottom-left identity opening
space.observation: The compact identity fits within its own opening with no visible clipping or leaf collision.

image_material.location: layered left monstera leaves and right planters
image_material.observation: Cut-paper-like planes, shaded overlaps, simple veins and pink containers create a consistent constructed illustration. The dense layering remains locally legible.

emotion_control.location: whole foliage enclosure
emotion_control.observation: The lush green enclosure is cheerful, but static and broadly botanical. Compared with M2 and M5, it gives less specific pleasure of choosing, meeting a grower or caring for a plant.

ai_slop.location: overlapping foliage and cream text channels
ai_slop.observation: The repeated leaves serve a consistent canopy structure; there are no conspicuous arbitrary badges, extra text or broken pot/plant constructions. Its generic frame is a conceptual weakness rather than evidence of a generated defect.

Oversized foliage around a light information opening relates closely to M1 and M4.
The identity is small and split at lower left, so the event/date carries more immediate recognition than the campaign name.

evidence.location: right tree pot with visible root section, left and bottom smaller specimens

evidence.location: large explanation and lower visit rows

evidence.location: surrounding foliage and right tree/root mass

evidence.location: broad paragraph and tall right tree
evidence.observation: A large three-line explanation and horizontal logistics rows oppose the tall root-bearing tree. This differs from M1 columns, M2 diagonal action, M3 date-first channels and M5 panelled invitation, with a residual shared foliage/cream-opening family.

content_form.location: right exposed-root planter and smaller pots around edges
content_form.observation: The contrast between a mature root-bearing tree and smaller potted specimens illustrates the range of plants and draws attention to their cultivation, linking the long explanation to actual nonglyph content.

hierarchy.location: large paragraph versus lower visit rows
hierarchy.observation: The explanation dominates with much larger type than the event identity and visit details. The horizontal date/hours/place row is readable but has few focal steps; finding the market information requires a second search after the paragraph.

hierarchy.location: central paragraph and small market block
hierarchy.observation: The paragraph remains the main text signal while the event information becomes a subdued cluster. This is functional but less resolved as an attendance invitation.

typography.location: serif Korean/Latin treatment across title, explanation and logistics
typography.observation: The serif system is consistent, visible glyphs and punctuation are intact, and broad paragraph wraps preserve the sentence structure.

typography.location: large paragraph and compact bottom rows
typography.observation: The paragraph is comfortably legible and the visit information still reads, although the small slogan, invitation and URL have substantially less visual weight.

space.location: wide left-center opening and right tree
space.observation: The tall tree balances the wide paragraph, while the bottom plant bed bounds the informational rows without clipping them.

space.location: date/hours/place and benefits rows
space.observation: Consistent row placement and spacing keep the three visit facts and paired benefits separate even within the smaller event block.

image_material.location: leaf veining, bark, exposed roots and ceramic pots
image_material.observation: Detailed botanical rendering is consistent across foliage, trunk and textured pots; the root opening reads as a sectional depiction of growth beneath the pot surface.

emotion_control.location: bright botanical scene and mature tree
emotion_control.observation: Warm light, abundant smaller plants and the visible root system give a patient growing-and-learning mood appropriate to home cultivation.

ai_slop.location: tree/root/pot construction and perimeter plants
ai_slop.observation: The exposed roots have a coherent explanatory relationship to the plant and pot. Repeated small leaves are botanical detail, and no arbitrary printed label or conspicuous broken object is visible.

residuals: The paragraph overwhelms the smaller market block, and the date/hours/place row lacks a strong focal sequence; hierarchy remains 3.
The smallest slogan, invitation and URL are legible at usage720 but receive little emphasis.
Its cream central opening and enveloping green foliage are related to M1 and M3 despite the different root subject and paragraph-led reading.

procedure.method: Fresh independent craft review in this session, without spawning, resuming, forking or reading peer/producer/planner records. Read the pinned packet, literal case, rules, rubric, recording method/addendum and adapter. Verified the declared byte/hash pins and PNG-header dimensions. The packet has no supplied source assets or protected layouts, so there were no source opens or protected-layout reads. Actually opened and visually inspected each exact poster through functions.exec tools.view_image with detail original, emitting the returned image at original detail, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, M5 in that same view order. Completed all fifteen opens before the focused first copy-reading/transcription stage, any image judgment, any rating or set judgment. Transcribed from the displayed native pixels after that opening pass, with usage720 and thumbnail320 used for scale/readability and composition observations. No OCR, replacement assets, crops, image edits or additional poster opens; no ambiguity-triggered revisit was needed. procedure.method: Independent fresh portfolio critic session; no spawned, resumed or forked agents and no peer/producer/planner records inspected. evidence.location: whole landscape and three text regions
evidence.observation: A flat, opaque single poster uses a large photographic plant montage, a two-line serif Korean title at left, paragraph in the middle, and a ruled visit column at right. This is an open-style result; a tape material is not required. No logo, QR, watermark, extra caption, or mockup framing is visible; the twelve supplied strings each appear once.

evidence.location: large upper planter and lower-left row of pots
evidence.observation: Substantial varied potted foliage, soil, glossy wet-looking leaves, and warm window light present a choice of living plants and the appeal of a tended indoor collection. The imagery occupies major areas and shapes the text clearings, exceeding tiny ornaments or texture attached to a passive gothic template.

evidence.location: center paragraph and right visit column
evidence.observation: The complete explanation is readable in four lines; market, date, hours, place, admission, care, invitation and URL form a connected right column with clear contrast.

evidence.location: whole composition in relation to the other members
evidence.observation: The large macro plant above a three-part horizontal reading route differs from M2's human counter scene, M3's date-led irregular clearings, M4's enlarged narrative and horizontal visit rows, and M5's dark panel with three image crops. The five are independently framed landscapes; complete-system differences are assessed in the set record.

style.checked_requirement:
덕테이프 포스터로 주말 식물 마켓을 홍보해줘. SNS에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 각각 전체 스타일과 레이아웃이 달랐으면 좋겠어. 식물을 고르고 집에서 돌보는 즐거움이 느껴지도록 만들고, 긴 설명과 방문 안내가 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 작은 이미지나 질감을 붙이는 단색 템플릿은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 다음 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

evidence.location: upper half and lower-left foreground
evidence.observation: Large living leaves, a soil-filled planter and a receding row of different potted houseplants form the visual content and frame the reading route; these are substantive nonglyph subjects.

evidence.location: upper half and lower-left foreground
evidence.observation: Large living leaves, a soil-filled planter and a receding row of different potted houseplants form the visual content and frame the reading route; these are substantive nonglyph subjects.

content_form.location: upper macro planter and lower-left display
content_form.observation: The healthy plant range fits the subject, but the concept remains a polished foliage showcase. Choosing is suggested by a row of pots; the social market and the practice of home care have little specific visual articulation beyond thriving plants and soil.

hierarchy.location: left title, center paragraph and right ruled information block
hierarchy.observation: A clear horizontal sequence moves from identity to explanation to visit details; the thin vertical rule keeps the date/place/services together without obscuring the imagery.

typography.location: two-line Korean serif title and sans-serif supporting text
typography.observation: The Korean title is distinctive and the long copy has intact glyphs, coherent spacing and sensible line lengths. The date and URL are clear.

typography.location: center explanation and right services
typography.observation: Body and visit information remain readable, with visible separation between primary facts and service lines.

space.location: pale center/right clearings and occupied left/top edges
space.observation: Text margins respond to the plant masses, with a deliberate narrow title zone, wider explanation zone and separated visit column. The left row recedes into space rather than becoming a tiny inset.

image_material.location: base of upper planter versus lower row of pots
image_material.observation: The large upper planter dissolves into a pale blur while the smaller pots sit on a receding bench. The scale and support relationship does not read as a fully coherent scene; the very slick leaf highlights further flatten the photographic montage.

emotion_control.location: whole foliage montage
emotion_control.observation: Sunlight and abundant green convey freshness, but the oversized pristine foliage and showroom-like rows produce a fairly generic lush-plant mood; the specific pleasure of selecting and caring feels less developed.

ai_slop.location: upper planter's fading underside and foreground pot surfaces
ai_slop.observation: The soft disappearance of the large planter into the copy clearing and the heavily mottled, similarly textured pots leave visible montage/construction residue. The layout is functional, but close inspection is not fully resolved.

residuals: Choosing and caring are suggested through a healthy plant display rather than a developed specific visual relationship.
The large planter's fading support/base and the two plant scales leave the montage less convincing under close inspection.
The emotional register is lush and polished but fairly generic.
Native 1672×941 is not mathematically 16:9; it passes the declared single-edge rounding rule because height differs from 1672×9/16 by exactly 0.5 pixel.

evidence.location: whole botanical landscape with cream clearing
evidence.observation: This is a single flat opaque landscape with detailed painted foliage, small pots, a large potted tree and a root-revealing opening in its planter. Serif type is permitted by the open style. The twelve required strings each appear once; no extra label, logo, watermark, QR or mockup framing is visible.

evidence.location: small lower pots and mature tree at right
evidence.observation: The scale range from small containers to a mature tree corresponds to the supplied plant range, while the visible roots connect the image to plant growth and care. These major subjects frame and occupy the poster rather than merely dressing an empty room or a tiny-image template.

evidence.location: large central explanation and lower horizontal visit rows
evidence.observation: The explanation reads in three large lines. Market, date, hours, place, admission, care, invitation and URL remain legible as grouped horizontal rows. The reading order is narrative-first after the small identity, with the practical information below.

evidence.location: composition relative to all five
evidence.observation: The enlarged explanation acts as the main typographic mass; a mature tree provides the right-side vertical anchor and visit data sits in rows. This differs from M1's macro montage and three columns, M2's active counter scene, M3's date-led clearings, and M5's dark collage, although botanical framing is shared with M1 and M3.

덕테이프 포스터로 주말 식물 마켓을 홍보해줘. SNS에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 각각 전체 스타일과 레이아웃이 달랐으면 좋겠어. 식물을 고르고 집에서 돌보는 즐거움이 느껴지도록 만들고, 긴 설명과 방문 안내가 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 작은 이미지나 질감을 붙이는 단색 템플릿은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 다음 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

content_form.location: tree at right, smaller pots and central clearing
content_form.observation: The small-to-mature plant range and root imagery relate to the supplied content, but the heavily overgrown garden-like setting gives little concrete sense of selecting a houseplant or living with it at home. Specific participation remains mostly in the text.

hierarchy.location: small upper identity, oversized explanation and compressed visit rows
hierarchy.observation: The large three-line explanation overwhelms both the identity and market name. Date, hours and place share a dense row, so the narrative emphasis is clear but the route into practical participation is less resolved.

typography.location: large Korean serif paragraph and smaller visit rows
typography.observation: The serif glyphs are intact, punctuation is clear, and the full paragraph's soft wraps remain grammatical. The Latin name and URL are consistently handled.

typography.location: center paragraph and lower facts
typography.observation: The main narrative and grouped visit lines remain legible without glyph collisions, despite the hierarchy imbalance.

space.location: cream center, large right tree and stepped bottom foliage
space.observation: The broad central clearing supports long lines, while the right trunk gives a vertical anchor and smaller pots step along the lower edge. Text is separated from the dense border rather than covered by it.

image_material.location: front opening of the large right planter
image_material.observation: The root-revealing cavity has a ragged dark boundary and roots hanging in an empty-looking space, while the surrounding planter is rendered as a solid decorative object. It reads partly as a cutaway and partly as a broken pot, leaving its construction less resolved than the foliage.

emotion_control.location: dense botanical border and mature tree
emotion_control.observation: Warm cream and greens create a pleasant botanical atmosphere, but the elaborate garden-like border and emphatic block of explanation are more ornamental and stately than the requested unhurried, personal joy of houseplant selection and care.

ai_slop.location: large root opening and densely stippled lower border
ai_slop.observation: The ambiguous cutaway-like planter opening and busy accumulation of tiny ground plants create visible construction residue. Abundant mottled surface detail does not fully clarify the spatial relation of the roots, container and surrounding garden.

residuals: The overgrown garden-like scene is less specific to choosing and tending houseplants at home.
The oversized explanation competes with market identity; practical data is compressed into horizontal rows.
The root-revealing planter opening has an unresolved cutaway/broken-container appearance.
Native 1672×941 is rounded rather than exact 16:9, with a permitted 0.5-pixel height residual.
